content.title: One Battle After Another
content.text: One Battle After Another USA | 2025 | 161 min. | Paul Thomas Anderson September 25 - November 3, 2025 Washed-up revolutionary Bob (Leonardo DiCaprio) exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa (Chase Infiniti). When his evil nemesis (Sean Penn) resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past. Director: Paul Thomas Anderson Principal Cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Benicio Del Toro, Sean Penn, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, Chase Infiniti, Alana Haim Country: USA Year: 2025 Running Time: 161 min. Producer: Paul Thomas Anderson, Sara Murphy, Adam Somner Screenplay: Paul Thomas Anderson Cinematographers: Paul Thomas Anderson, Michael Bauman Editors: Andy Jurgensen Music: Jonny Greewood Website: Official Film Website Format: DCP US Distributor: Warner Brothers X
